title: Parsing Records and Input Validation
learningObjectives: Explain the main rules of record parsing and validation.
Identify the key C++ constructs used for record parsing and validation.
Apply record parsing and validation in a small program.
Recognize common failure cases and safety concerns.
Test a practical scenario and justify the chosen approach.

understand.concept: Parsing extracts fields from raw text; validation checks the values against rules. Use string streams to parse into temporary variables, verify extraction, ranges and extra tokens before accepting the record.
understand.whyItMatters: External files and user input can be malformed. Validation keeps bad data from entering program state.
